versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Units that die or are sold leave a Sprout in their slot, sized by how many have gone this fight or turn.
Selling and dying are the same event, so the Guild plans its funerals in the shop and in fights.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Closed Stinkhorn's free sell loop and fixed a Sprout's size when it is summoned; Inkcap's Health loss now reads plainly.
Sprouts now carry hero damage, Lamplighter reads the Register, and Old Fingers' copies have Fruit.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Old Fingers' copies now have defined stats, last one fight and are never dug up again; Sexton, Amanita and Candlesnuff say plainly what they count or keep.
Hired Mute grows +1/+1 when a unit beside it falls, so the seed joins the funeral-order puzzle.
